name: g67_update_sitrus_tie
purpose: Step G67 regression, the post-residual each:Update tie of two equally fast Sitrus Berry holders (mechanism 2 of campaign seed 6700000 battle 10, a follow-on error of the hit-loop Update). Both sides lead with Reuniclus (Sitrus Berry, Psychic, Protect) and Staraptor; no Substitute, no weather (Tyranitar is benched). The two Reuniclus hit each other with Psychic and both eat their Sitrus Berry in the same turn; the Updates of the turn, the last one after the residual, draw the tie of their holders.
